texts.zh: 怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。
texts.en: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

sections.zh:
我们的文明，其本质在于对冒险的渴望。

发现失落的宝藏，探索古老的遗迹，挖掘超越我们时代的文物；这些事件构成了我们最著名的故事，并激励着我们的社会代代相传。

那么，当我们首次进军太空时，出现的冒险号召是巧合还是命运？一颗神秘的、来源不明的太空舱被发现环绕着我们的星球。舱内是一张指向星辰的加密星图。

经过多年的努力，我们终于拥有了解密这张星图并规划航线的技术。当我们向星系边疆进发时，我们团结一致，决心踏上我们有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。
sections.en:
Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.

Discovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.

So was it coincidence or fate when our first foray into space produced a call to adventure? A mysterious capsule of unknown providence was discovered orbiting our planet. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.

After years of hard work, we now have the technology to decipher this map and chart a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

sections.zh:
我们的文明以对冒险的热衷而著名。

寻找失传已久的宝藏、探索古老的遗迹、发掘远古时代的遗物……如此种种构成了我们最广为流传的传奇故事，并激励着我们的社会数代人。

那么，当我们在漫无目的中撞见了冒险的召唤，这究竟是巧合还是命运的安排呢？在探索未知星系的过程中，我们找到了一个天意难测的神秘胶囊，里面有一份引向群星的加密星图。

经过多年的研究，我们终于破译了这张星图，并规划出了前往未被探索区域的路线。我们团结一致，朝着星系的边疆启航，决心踏上有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。
sections.en:
Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.

Discovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.

So was it coincidence or fate when our wanderings led us to a call to adventure? Exploring an uncharted system, we recovered a mysterious capsule of unknown providence. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.

After years of study, we have at last deciphered this map and charted a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

label.zh: 开局第1天：神秘胶囊与星图
label.en: Day 1: the mysterious capsule and star chart

texts.zh: 我们对[this.GetHomeWorldName]发现的远古胶囊有了新的发现。得益于我们[this.GetScientistPlural]孜孜不倦的工作，现在将要完成解密数字密保的最后一层，破译令我们着迷已久的图表。
texts.en: We have made a breakthrough regarding the Ancient Capsule found orbiting [this.GetHomeWorldName]. Thanks to the tireless efforts of our [this.GetScientistPlural], we are now in a position to decrypt the final layer of digital security and decipher the chart that has intrigued us for so long.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一张神秘的星图，于是决定踏上最伟大的冒险之旅。谁知道星国图志的尽头隐藏着什么，以及我们在旅途中会遇到什么危险。
texts.en: After discovering a mysterious map to the stars, we embarked on our greatest adventure. Who knows what lies at the end of the Celestial Chart, and what dangers we may face on our journey.

texts.zh: 我们对轨道胶囊内包含的海图进行了初步分析，发现许多天体的位置并不在我们母星系内。还需要一些时间才能提取准确的坐标。
texts.en: Our initial analysis of the chart inside of the orbital capsule revealed the location of several celestial bodies not present in our home system. It will take time to extract the exact coordinates.

texts.zh:
这张海图并不完整！

轨道胶囊内的数据支离破碎，每一个明显的缺口都像是拼图中缺失的一块。尽管如此，它还是揭示了一个以前未知的恒星系坐标，然而关于在那里等待着我们的是什么并没有提供任何细节。

该海图还突出了一系列用来进行超空间航行到达该目的地的突破点。
texts.en:
The chart is only partially complete!

The data within the orbital capsule is fragmented, each conspicuous gap like the missing piece of a puzzle. Nevertheless, it reveals the coordinates of a previously-unknown star system, but does not provide any detail as to what awaits us there.

The chart also highlights a series of established breach points to facilitate hyperlane travel to the destination.

texts.zh:
在胶囊里发现的星图吸引了全社会的注意。现在证明这不过是整张星图的冰山一角，不知道它将会把我们带向何处、找到什么。我们决定要完成这份《星国图志》。

我们的舰队蓄势待发，准备踏上我们文明的下一段征途。
texts.en:
The discovery of the chart inside of the capsule has captured the attention of our society. Now that it has been revealed to be a piece among many, we wonder where it may lead and what we might find there. We are determined to complete this "Celestial Chart".

Our ships are standing by, eager to set forth on our civilization's next great adventure.

texts.zh:
[this.GetHomeWorldName]的人口沉迷于最近解密的星图。人们叫它《星国图志》，它目前带来的更多是疑问而非答案。它从何而来？是由谁出于什么目的撰写？而且或许最重要的是——这会把我们带向陷阱吗？

我们的舰队蓄势待发，准备踏上我们文明的下一段征途。
texts.en:
The population of [this.GetHomeWorldName] is enthralled with the recently deciphered star chart. Commonly referred to as the "Celestial Chart", so far it provides more questions than answers. Where did it come from? Who created it, and for what purpose? And perhaps most importantly - will it lead us into a trap?

Our ships are standing by, eager to set forth on our civilization's next great adventure.

label.zh: 舰船首次进入星图标出的目标星系
label.en: A ship first enters the target system marked on the star chart

texts.zh:
我们遇到了一支悬挂不明旗帜的、全副武装的舰队。他们的船只列阵整齐，但设计五花八门。许多都配备了动能发射器，连接着挂碳钢钩和鱼叉的粗缆线。此外，在舰队中央还有一组装甲输送车。我们只能猜测这些船只是由一群海盗或雇佣兵控制的。

我们收到了他们领头船发来的信号。
texts.en:
We have encountered a heavily-armed fleet flying under an unknown flag. Their ships are in organized formation but not uniform in their design. Many are outfitted with kinetic launchers attached to reels of thick cable tipped with carbon steel hooks and harpoons. Additionally, there is a group of armored haulers sheltered in the center of the fleet. We can only surmise that these ships are controlled by a group of pirates or mercenaries.

We are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

title.en: Captain Hoo of the Black Needle

texts.zh:
这位不法之徒的首领高傲而冷淡，装出一副漫不经心的样子。他说话时低头看着自己的喙，拒绝与我们对视，仿佛我们不值得他全神贯注。他用羽毛做着无意间滑稽的动作。

你已经冒犯了黑针，你惹上麻烦了！

我们听说你这新兴的小社会将探索这个恒星系。你偶然发现了一张明显属于我们的星图。交出来，否则别怪我们不客气。
texts.en:
Distinguished and haughty, this outlaw captain feigns disinterest. He looks down his beak when speaking and refuses to meet our gaze, as if we are unworthy of his full attention. He gesticulates with his feathers in an inadvertently comical manner.

You have crossed the path of the Black Needle, a blunder on your part!

We caught wind of a rumor that your burgeoning little society would be exploring this system. You have stumbled upon a chart that clearly belongs to us. Hand it over, lest things become violent.

responses.zh:
我正是荷仁！我的全名是格里马荷·泽门德仁，但你也可以叫我荷仁船长，正是白银之风的船长，也是伟大的黑针海盗阁下手下的二副。几千年来，我们的羽翼已经深植各种法外买卖，而我不过是我们华丽挂毯上的一缕银丝。

你最好记住我的名字，因为我希望在把这张图表交给我们无与伦比的领袖后能得到丰厚的赏金。
responses.en:
Hoo I am! My name is Glimarhoo Zelmendrion, but you may refer to me as Captain Hoo, Captain of the Silverwing and Second Mate Lieutenant of the illustrious Black Needle pirates. We have had our feathers in every variety of illicit dealings for thousands of years, and I am but one thread in the majestic tapestry of our legacy.

You would do well to remember my name, as I expect a significant bounty after presenting this chart to our peerless leader.

label.zh: 关于这星图你们有什么头绪？
label.en: What do you know of the chart?

responses.zh:
一位才华横溢、价格不菲的掮客告诉我们，你们最近偶然发现了一个奇特的胶囊……它里面应该有一个我们非常感兴趣的隐藏星系的位置。

我们当然也拥有这星图的一部分，但如果不配上你们手上的那一份就毫无作用。真搞不懂为什么奈斯船长要把她遗产的钥匙交给你们，但我们可有责任来帮你保管好它。
responses.en:
A talented, and very expensive, information broker informed us that you recently stumbled upon a peculiar capsule... A capsule that is supposed to contain directions to a hidden system of great interest to us.

We ourselves have also claimed a piece of the chart, but it is useless without the data from your capsule. I cannot fathom why Captain Ness would give you the key to her legacy, but it falls to us to relieve you of it.

label.zh: 你们为什么这么想要这个星图？
label.en: Why do you want this chart so badly?

responses.zh:
你是蠢还是怎么的？[this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult]我大概是要一点一点掰碎了给你讲了。

星图的作用是作为一种指向特定目的地的导航指引。我们想去那个地方，拿回遗失已久的奈斯船长的宝藏。
responses.en:
Are you really quite so naive? [this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult] I guess I have to spell it out for you.

A chart functions as a form of navigatory guidance towards a specific destination. We wish to visit that destination and claim the long-lost treasure of Captain Ness.

responses.zh:
嗨，我还以为你们会更清楚呢。她就是这张星图的制作人。也许她发现你们的种族无知到可以托付吧，她就是那种会莫名恐惧的人。

不过这终究不关你的事。把情报交出来，让我们带走它。
responses.en:
We thought you would be better informed. She is the one who created this chart. Perhaps she found your species' ignorance to be relatable, the thoughtless terror that she was.

Ultimately, it is none of your concern. Hand over the information and we will take it from here.

label.zh: 我们是不会交出星图的。
label.en: We will be keeping our chart.

responses.zh:
想想也是。那就准备见鬼去吧。

拿来吧你！
responses.en:
I thought as much. Prepare to meet your fate.

Stand and deliver!

label.en: After closing communications and engaging, the Black Needle is disabled

label.zh: 有本事你来拿呀，你这蠢蛋！
label.en: Come and take it, ya rust sucker!

label.zh: 有本事你来拿呀，你这蠢蛋！
label.en: Come and take it, ya rust sucker!

title.en: Captain Hoo of the Black Needle

texts.zh:
你侮辱我就罢了，你还侮辱黑针！这忍不了，一点也忍不了！

你拒绝合作的态度我们会记着的。黑针会用一切手段来结训你。我们易怒之下就能把你那小小的初生文明给弄死。

不交出那张星图我们是不会罢休的！今天就先放你们一马！
texts.en:
You have made a mockery of myself and the Black Needle. This will not stand, not at all!

Your unwillingness to cooperate will not soon be forgotten. The Black Needle will come at you with all that we have. Your fledgling civilization will not survive our wrath.

We will not stop until that chart is ours! And now I shall bid you good day!

label.en: Next time, talk less and fight more!

label.zh: 勘察碎裂世界后打捞星图片；已勘察则立即开放
label.en: Recover the chart fragment after surveying the shattered world; available immediately if already surveyed

texts.zh:
星国图志引导我们来到一个粉碎星球。我们探测到一条非自然形成的隧道深深钻入了行星最大地壳板块。相信星图的下一部分就隐藏在里面，但需要仔细挖掘才能获取。

可以用工程船来建造必要的设备从而发掘出这块星图碎片。
texts.en:
The Celestial Chart has led us to a shattered world. We detected an unnatural tunnel drilled into the largest slab of planetary crust. We believe that the next piece of our chart is hidden within, but accessing it will require careful excavation.

A construction ship would be able to build the necessary equipment to extract the piece.

texts.zh:
我们从漂浮的行星碎片中提取出了一个胶囊和一些矿物。打开以后，我们发现了另一块星国图志的碎片，以及一些独特的文物。此外，在里面发现了一张字条，为了便于翻译它还使用了多种语言撰写。

“这里是索罗佩格玛的最后废墟，乙特人母星。乙特人是一个前超光速物种，由于一场悲惨的事故而灭绝。我们没有意识到即将到来的后果，意外触发了被盗巨像的破坏力量。请保护和尊重他们的记忆。”
texts.en:
A capsule was successfully extracted from the drifting planetary debris alongside a quantity of minerals. Upon opening it, we discovered a new piece of the Celestial Chart and a selection of unique cultural artifacts. Additionally, a note was found inside, written in multiple languages to allow for easier translation.

"This is all that remains of Soropegma, the Ytterite homeworld. The Ytterite were a Pre-FTL species rendered extinct as a result of a tragic accident. Unaware of the impending consequences, we accidentally triggered the destructive power of a stolen Colossus. Please preserve and respect their memory."

label.zh: 可选展览支线：此前已提出档案馆计划
label.en: Optional exhibition: archive proposal already made

label.zh: 可选展览支线：尚未提出档案馆计划，且未掌握银河档案学
label.en: Optional exhibition: archive proposal not made and Galactic Archivism not researched

texts.zh: 从破碎行星的残骸中挖掘出胶囊后，我们需要破译其中的导航数据。这个过程需要交叉参照我们的制图数据库，并将标记的天体与已知星系进行比对。
texts.en: After excavating the capsule from the remains of the shattered planet, we need to decipher the navigation data within. This process will require cross-referencing our cartographic database and charting the marked celestial bodies against known systems.

texts.zh: 突破多层加密后，新数据被无缝地添加到星国图志中。当所有碎片拼凑完成，一个全新的星系跃然眼前。我们旅程的下一步近在咫尺，应该谨慎地去探索这片未测绘的太空区域。
texts.en: After breaking multiple layers of encryption, the new data was added seamlessly to the Celestial Chart. Once the pieces were combined, yet another new system was revealed. The next step of our journey lies before us. We should approach this uncharted area of space with caution.

label.zh: 勘察黑针基地行星，或取得该星系
label.en: Survey the Black Needle base planet, or gain its system

texts.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个带有黑针标志的秘密地下基地。我们认为这是一个海盗集团的外部基地，与他们的其他行动隔离开来。星国图志的下一部分一定存放在这里，很可能与其他财富和装饰品一起。

我们可以轻松地对基地进行轨道轰炸，但这可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。另一方面，快速部署地面部队将更快地夺取基地，杀他们个措手不及。

更隐秘的方法是入侵基地的计算机系统，直接大胆地抢走星国图志的那一部分。
texts.en:
We have found a covert underground base on [From.GetName] bearing the insignia of the Black Needle. We believe that this is an external base used by the piracy group, isolated from their other operations. The next piece of the Celestial Chart must be stored here, likely alongside other riches and baubles.

We could easily begin orbital bombardment of the base, but this may give the Black Needle the time they need to call for reinforcements. On the other hand, a rapid deployment of our ground forces would more swiftly seize the base, giving little time for the enemy to respond.

A more clandestine approach would be to hack into the base's computer systems and secure the Celestial Chart piece in a daring heist.

texts.zh: 海盗过度依赖偷窃和改装技术，这导致他们的基地容易受到渗透。可以让一艘科研船从轨道上入侵[FromFrom.GetName]的网络，伪装成黑针运输船，并声称受荷仁船长的命令，说服他们移交星图胶囊，避免不必要的流血事件。
texts.en: The pirates' over-reliance on stolen and repurposed tech has left their base vulnerable to infiltration. A single research ship could hack the network on [FromFrom.GetName] from orbit, masquerading as a Black Needle transport vessel under orders of Captain Hoo. This might convince them to transfer custody of the map capsule without needless bloodshed.

texts.zh: 经过数月的准备，科学家[Leader.GetName]成功潜入了通讯网络，并伪装成了一艘黑针飞船。在伪造的荷仁船长命令下，[Leader.GetHeShe]欺骗了基地操作员，让他们准备将星图胶囊进行紧急星际转移。
texts.en: After months of preparation, Scientist [Leader.GetName] successfully infiltrated the communications network and impersonated a Black Needle vessel. Under fabricated orders from Captain Hoo, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] tricked the base operators into preparing the capsule for emergency off-world transfer.

texts.zh: 通过灵压，[Leader.GetName]轻易地便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
texts.en: Through psionic coercion, [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] easily able to manipulate the inferior minds of the guards to avoid further suspicions.

texts.zh: [Leader.Species.GetHandName]轻轻一挥，科学家[Leader.GetName]便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
texts.en: With a simple flick of the [Leader.Species.GetHandName], Scientist [Leader.GetName] manipulated the minds of the guards to allay any suspicions.

texts.zh: 凭借他们的魅力，科学家[Leader.GetName]能够避开任何棘手的问题。
texts.en: Using their charisma and charm, Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] able to avoid any difficult questions.

texts.zh: 科学家[Leader.GetName]将飞船降落一个绝佳位置，以便在掩护被揭穿的情况下迅速撤退。
texts.en: Scientist [Leader.GetName] landed their vessel in perfect position to make a hasty retreat in case their cover was blown.

texts.zh: 我们成功夺得胶囊，无人员伤亡。海盗们还没有意识到他们被骗了。
texts.en: The capsule was secured with no casualties. The pirates have not yet understood that they were duped.

texts.zh: 我们从黑针基地获取了星图胶囊，接下来的任务是解密其中的数据，并将新信息整合到星国图志中。
texts.en: With the capsule taken from the Black Needle base, we are tasked with decrypting the data within and integrating the new information into the Celestial Chart.

texts.zh:
我们成功突破了数字加密层，并将新信息整合到星国图志中。这又让我们发现了另一个值得探索的目的地，现在星图几乎完整了。我们相信只剩下最后一块拼图，并谨慎乐观地认为我们的探索即将结束。

在解码导航数据的同时，我们也认为无瑕的舱体外壳值得分析。容器的强度和耐用性令人惊讶；复制这种材料的能力可以为未来的研究提供许多潜在的机会。
texts.en:
We successfully overcame the layers of digital encryption and integrated new information into the Celestial Chart. This revealed yet another destination to explore and now the chart is almost complete. We believe that there is only one piece of the puzzle remaining, and are cautiously optimistic that the end of our quest is in sight.

While the navigational data was being decoded, the unblemished exterior of the capsule itself was deemed worthy of analysis. The strength and durability of the container was surprising; the ability to replicate this material could provide many potential opportunities for future research.

label.zh: 勘察斯米吉卜的藏身星球，或取得该星系
label.en: Survey Smeegibb's shelter planet, or gain its system

texts.zh:
我们在[FROM.GetName]发现了一个小型定居点，人口不到一千，居民是一些感性软体动物。对该物种的初步生物学分析表明，它们具有亚空间突触交流的能力，表明存在一个蜂巢思维。除了这个孤立的营地外，这颗星球上没有其他智慧生命。

也许这个物种对我们听说过的“奈斯船长”有更多信息。

为什么我们会被星国图志导向这里尚不清楚，需要进一步调查。
texts.en:
We have found a small settlement on [FROM.GetName] with a population of less than a thousand sentient molluscoids. Preliminary biological analysis of the species shows a capacity for subspace ephapse communication, indicating the existence of a hive mind. Other than this isolated encampment, the planet is uninhabited by any other sentient life.

Perhaps this species has more information on this "Captain Ness" we have heard about.

Why the Celestial Chart has led us here is not yet clear and requires further investigation.

We have found a small settlement on [FROM.GetName] with a population of less than a thousand sentient molluscoids. Preliminary biological analysis of the species shows a capacity for subspace ephapse communication, indicating the existence of a hive mind. Other than this isolated encampment, the planet is uninhabited by any other sentient life.

Why the Celestial Chart has led us here is not yet clear and requires further investigation.

texts.zh:
这是一个隐藏在[FROM.GetName]星系中的蜂巢思维节点，斯密吉卜不安地扭动着。他们习惯于服从，因此在被说话时会习惯性地低下头。

斯马拉克！我们已经有很长时间没有同另一个集体意识物种交谈了。

我们叫斯密吉卜。我们很好奇你是怎么找到我们的。这个恒星系已经隐藏在星系视野之外数千年了。

只有船长知道这个地方。你想要找什么？
texts.en:
A node of the hive mind found in the hidden system of [FROM.GetName], Smeegibb fidgets with discomfort. They have a tendency to lower their gaze when spoken to, as if they are accustomed to subservience.

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to other groupmind.

Our name is Smeegibb. We are curious how you find us. This system is hidden from galactic view for thousands of years.

Only The Captain knows this place. You seek what?

texts.zh:
这是一个隐藏在[FROM.GetName]星系中的蜂巢思维节点，斯密吉卜不安地扭动着。他们习惯于服从，因此在被说话时会习惯性地低下头。

斯马拉克！我们已经有很长时间没有同一心物种交谈了。

我们叫斯密吉卜。我们很好奇你是怎么找到我们的。这个恒星系已经隐藏在星系视野之外数千年了。

只有船长知道这个地方。你想要找什么？
texts.en:
A node of the hive mind found in the hidden system of [FROM.GetName], Smeegibb fidgets with discomfort. They have a tendency to lower their gaze when spoken to, as if they are accustomed to subservience.

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to oneminds.

Our name is Smeegibb. We are curious how you find us. This system is hidden from galactic view for thousands of years.

Only The Captain knows this place. You seek what?

responses.zh:
斯马拉克！这个星球是我们的居住地，我们生活在远离星系暴力的安全之中。以前，我们曾参与过暴力。杀戮、犯罪、海盗行径——我们什么都干过。但现在不再如此，我们只照顾我们的水培农场。

在当海盗之前，我们是难民，没有人愿意收留我们，除了船长。她救助我们脱离了悲惨的命运，并允许我们加入她的船队。船长给了我们一个新名字，作为交换，我们负责照顾飞船。

我们负责清洁、烹饪、弹药、水栽和货物管理。我们辛勤工作。然后我们加入了登船突击队。船长盗取宝藏或劫掠时保护她。绝不背叛船长。我们始终忠诚。
responses.en:
Smarak! This planet is our quarters. We live twicesafe, far from a violent galaxy. Before now, we join violence. Killing, crime, piracy - we do it all. No more. We tend our hydroponics.

Before then, we are refugees. No one takes us in, until The Captain. She saves us from a bad fate and allows us to join her crew. The Captain gives us a new name and in exchange we take care of ship.

We do cleaning, cooking, munitions, hydroponics and cargo. We work. Then we join boarding party. Protect The Captain when she steals treasure or does kidnapping. Never betray The Captain. Always we are loyal.

label.zh: 你对星国图志有何了解？
label.en: What do you know about the Celestial Chart?

responses.zh:
斯玛拉克！我们对什么导航图一无所知，我们只待在自己的房间里。如果船长做了一张导航图把你带到这里，一定有她的理由……她想帮助我们，或者伤害我们。我们永远无法确定。船长很狡猾。

她有时会给我们发消息。船长给我们送来了一座她最喜欢的子个体的巨型雕像，那是她救出过的斯密吉卜并且一直记得。它很令人印象深刻，但我们不知道她为什么要送。也许她想道歉，但她没有留下任何纸条。
responses.en:
Smarak! We know no chart, we only stay in our quarters. If The Captain makes a chart to bring you here, there must be a reason why... She wants to help us, or harm us. We are never sure. The Captain can be tricky.

She messages us at one time. The Captain sends us a giant statue of her favorite drone, the Smeegibb she remembers and she saves from before. It is impressive, but we know not why she sends. Maybe she wants to apologize, but she gives no note.

label.zh: 和我们聊聊船长的更多事情。
label.en: Tell us more about The Captain.

responses.zh:
斯玛拉克！以前，船长拯救了我们。以前，她是我们的导师和领袖。她教我们如何照顾飞船。她说：“斯密吉卜，做军需官、机械师和劳工——你很有价值。”

船长遵循两条信条：“财富即独立”和“生命在于传承”。我们一起猎杀穷人和富人。我们从暴力的星系中夺取我们想要的东西。

但后来船长变得愈发贪婪和鲁莽。她牺牲船员，或者为了赏金背叛他们。船长失去了所有人，除了斯密吉卜。我们始终忠诚。

她让我们看到了星系的暴力。现在我们只想远离它。
responses.en:
Smarak! Before now, The Captain saves us. Before she is our mentor and leader. She teaches us to take care of ship. She says "Smeegibb, work as quartermaster, mechanic, and labor - you are excellent value."

The Captain lives by two creeds: "Wealth is independence" and "Life exists for legacy". Together we hunt the poor and rich. We take what we want from violent galaxy.

But then The Captain is twicegreedy and twicereckless. She sacrifices crewmates or betrays them for bounty. The Captain loses everyone but Smeegibb. Always we are loyal.

She shows us how violent galaxy is. Now we prefer to stay away.

label.zh: 星图为什么会带领我们来到这里？
label.en: Why did our Chart lead us here?

responses.zh:
斯玛拉克！我们不知道船长为什么把你带到这里。她什么也没告诉我们。

我们有个想法。有一个地方，船长和我们在那一起躲避赏金猎人。安全的地方。也许你能在那里找到一些东西。
responses.en:
Smarak! We are not sure why The Captain brings you here. She tells us nothing.

There is one idea. There is a place where together The Captain and we hide from bountydogs. Safe quarters. Maybe you find something there.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]遇到的生物，斯密吉卜，透露了一个废弃的安全屋的坐标，该安全屋以前由他们和奈斯船长居住。调查这个地点可能会让我们找到星国图志的下一部分，或者至少是一条线索，指引我们走向正确的方向。
texts.en: The being we encountered on [from.GetName], Smeegibb, has revealed the coordinates of an abandoned safehouse formerly occupied by themselves and Captain Ness. Investigating this location may lead us to the next piece of the Celestial Chart, or at least a clue to guide us in the right direction.

texts.zh: 在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的冰冷荒原上，我们发现了一个小型预制庇护所，里面配备了休眠的生命维持系统和生活区。它们经过数千年的冰暴，严重风化，部分被掩埋。
texts.en: On the frigid wastelands of [fromfrom.planet.GetName], we have detected a small prefabricated shelter equipped with dormant life support devices and living quarters. They are heavily weathered and partially buried after millennia of ice storms.

sections.zh: 在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的冰冷荒原上，我们发现了一个小型预制庇护所，里面配备了休眠的生命维持系统和生活区。它们经过数千年的冰暴，严重风化，部分被掩埋。
sections.en: On the frigid wastelands of [fromfrom.planet.GetName], we have detected a small prefabricated shelter equipped with dormant life support devices and living quarters. They are heavily weathered and partially buried after millennia of ice storms.

texts.zh:
挖掘出的建筑显示出长期使用的迹象。它曾经拥有充足的基本设施。在整个建筑中发现了零散的饰品和奇珍异宝。在一堆凌乱的纸张中，我们找到了由奈斯船长本人写下的日志条目。

我们登上并劫持了另一艘佩里坎的珍宝运输船，但这次他们已经做好了准备。附带损失比我想象的要多一些，但我们解决过更糟糕的情况。不错的收益，但塔皮科宝石仍然在逃。不幸的是，现在佩里坎人又提高了赏金，联邦也介入了。现在情况有点棘手。可能需要避一避风头。
texts.en:
The excavated structure showed evidence of long periods of use. It was once well-stocked with basic amenities. Trinkets and curios have been discovered strewn throughout the building. Within a pile of messy papers, we recovered a log entry written by Captain Ness herself.

We boarded and hijacked another Perikan treasury transport, but this time they were ready for us. More collateral than I'd like, but we've handled worse. Decent payout, but the Tapico Jewel continues to elude us. Unfortunately, now the Perikans have increased their bounty again and the Federation has gotten involved. Things are a bit hot right now. Might need to lay low for a while.

texts.zh:
在结构下方的挖掘发现了一小批贵重物品和基本的卫生系统。不幸的是，在彻底搜查了该区域后，我们未能找到任何关于星国图志碎片的痕迹。

我们收集了更多笔记本和文件，希望能从奈斯船长散乱的日志条目中找到线索。

在像斯密吉卜这样的伙伴陪伴下时间过得没那么慢，但值得分享荣耀吗？当然，与一个蜂巢思维合作有难以置信的价值。用仅仅一份利润的份额换取数百个子个体的使用权？真是个好交易！但也许他们所做的工作会削弱我自己的成就……？我不确定我是否能接受分享自己遗产的想法。我需要再仔细考虑一下。
texts.en:
Digging beneath the structure revealed a small stash of valuables and basic sanitation systems. Unfortunately, after scouring the area completely, we were unable to find any evidence of a piece of the Celestial Chart.

We have collected more notebooks and papers in the hope of discovering a clue within Captain Ness's scattered log entries.

Time passes less slowly with a partner like Smeegibb, but is it worth splitting the glory? Sure, working with a hive mind has incredible value. Access to hundreds of drones in exchange for just a single cut of the profits? What a deal! But maybe the work they do takes away from my own achievements...? I'm not sure I can live with the idea of sharing my legacy. I'll need to give this more thought.

texts.zh:
在一个通风口里，我们发现了奈斯船长的最后日记。

我不想以这种方式被记住。斯密吉卜一直是我的忠实伙伴，但不要说我需要他们。我可以独自征服星系。我会留下我的印记，荣耀将属于我。还有财富。

给自己留个笔记：最好给斯密吉卜送点东西留作纪念。

这就是我们能找到的全部。没有关于船长或星国图志的任何其他线索。

也许给斯密吉卜的礼物中包含着关于最后一块碎片下落的线索。我们必须重新与他们建立联系。
texts.en:
Concealed within an air vent, we discovered Captain Ness' final journal entry.

This isn't how I want to be remembered. Smeegibb has been a loyal companion, but never let it be said I needed them. I can take on the galaxy solo. I'll leave MY mark, and the glory will be mine. As well as the riches.

Note to self: Better send Smeegibb something to remember me by.

This is all there is left to find. There is no other trace of the Captain or any sign of the Celestial Chart.

Perhaps the gift to Smeegibb that was mentioned holds some clue to the whereabouts of the final piece. We must re-open communications with them.

label.zh: 发掘结束一天后，藏身星系中没有己方舰队
label.en: One day after excavation, if none of your fleets is in the shelter system

label.zh: 发掘结束一天后，己方舰队已在藏身星系
label.en: One day after excavation, if your fleet is already in the shelter system

texts.zh:
我们无法重新与斯密吉卜建立通讯。由于这是我们获得星国图志下一部分的唯一线索，我们应该返回[smeegibb_system.GetName]调查情况。目前尚不清楚通讯突然中断的原因。

我希望我们新近发现的朋友还安全。
texts.en:
We were unable to re-establish communications with Smeegibb. As our only clue to the next piece of the Celestial Chart, we should return to [smeegibb_system.GetName] to investigate the situation. The reason behind the sudden break in contact is currently unknown.

We hope that our newfound friend is safe.

texts.zh: 我们无法重新与斯密吉卜建立通讯。由于这是我们获得星国图志下一部分的唯一线索，我们应该返回[smeegibb_system.GetName]调查情况。目前尚不清楚通讯突然中断的原因。
texts.en: We were unable to re-establish communications with Smeegibb. As our only clue to the next piece of the Celestial Chart, we should return to [smeegibb_system.GetName] to investigate the situation. The reason behind the sudden break in contact is currently unknown.

label.zh: 派遣舰队返回藏身星系调查
label.en: Send a fleet back to investigate the shelter system

texts.zh:
一支印着名为黑针的海盗组织的旗帜的庞大舰队，被发现正在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]轨道上运行。我们相信这些海盗一直在跟踪我们的行动，并且已经夷平了名为斯密吉卜的集体的居所。他们一定还在寻找星国图志的下一部分。

该星球上没有发现任何智慧生命迹象。

我们正在接收来自他们旗舰的信号。
texts.en:
A sizable fleet bearing the flag of the pirate organization known as the Black Needle has been sighted orbiting [smeegibb_shelter.GetName]. We believe that these pirates have been shadowing our movements, and have razed the settlement housing the collective known as Smeegibb. They must still be searching for the next piece of the Celestial Chart.

No signs of sentient life remain on the planet.

We are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

title.en: Captain Inax of the Black Needle

texts.zh:
这节肢动物昂首挺胸，复眼闪着耀眼的光芒。它严谨的姿态与不安的口器形成鲜明对比，口器不规则地咔哒作响，兴奋地颤抖着。

所以，我们终于见面了。你们这些软甲生物是怎么战胜荷—荷—荷仁舰长的！？即使是那个老糊涂也应该轻而易举地消灭你们可怜的舰队。你们将为搞—搞—搞砸我们在[black_needle_base.GetName]的基地付出代价。

感—感—感谢你带我们到这里，银羽追捕那些可怜的斯密吉卜超过一百个周期。了结他古老的怨恨意味着我将获得丰厚的赏金……在我解决了你之后。
texts.en:
This arthopoid stands tall, its compound eyes glaring brightly. A disciplined demeanor is at odds with the fidgeting of mandibles, which irregularly click and shiver with excitement.

So, we finally meet. How did you softshells manage to defeat K-k-kaptain Hoo? Even that old k-k-kretin should have easily eliminated your pitiful fleet. You will pay for ransack-k-king our base on [black_needle_base.GetName].

Thank-k-k you for leading us here. Silver Quill hunted that pitiful Smeegibb for over one hundred cycles. Settling one of his ancient grudges means I'm due for a big bounty... Once I'm through with you.

responses.zh:
称呼—呼—呼我为伊纳克斯，是黑—黑—黑针的少将。

能被我送下黄—黄—黄泉，你们真是得了个好死，劝你们乖乖送上命来。

按惯—惯—惯例，我赏你最先上路。
responses.en:
K-k-kall me Inax, Rear Admiral of the Black-k-k Needle.

Now you know the name of the one who will k-k-kill you. This is an honorable death. I advise you to embrace it.

As is k-k-kustom, you may even take the first shot.

responses.zh:
这简直小菜一碟。我用那些小蛞—蛞—蛞蝓蓝色的血给他们的棚屋上了个漆。一没舰队二没武器——早晚都得被干—干—干死。黑—黑—黑针所刺，无人幸存。

那是你熟人吗？好怪—怪—怪啊。马上你就会和他们团聚了。以银羽之名，我们要从你们熄灭的铁罐—罐—罐头上拿走星图。
responses.en:
They were no challenge. We painted their hovel with blue mollusk-k-koid blood. No fleet, no weapons - someone would have whack-k-ked them sooner or later. No one pierced by the Black-k-k Needle and survives.

They were your friend? How k-k-kuaint. You will be joining them very soon. In the name of Silver Quill, we will have that chart as your lights flick-k-ker and die.

responses.zh:
银羽是谁？真是个好—好—好问题。我们传奇的创始人运筹帷幄。他从一叶孤帆，把黑—黑—黑针打造成为一个星系大事业。

黑—黑—黑针会为了歌—歌—歌颂他的丰功伟绩而继续存在下去，而你们的死亡就是这首颂词的下一个音符。
responses.en:
Who is Silver Quill? What a k-k-kuestion. Our legendary founder was a mastermind. From a single ship, he built the Black-k-k Needle into a galaxy-spanning enterprise.

The Black-k-k Needle lives on to k-k-karry on his legacy. Your death will be the next note in our song.

label.zh: 你想要星国图志做什么？
label.en: What do you want with the Celestial Chart?

responses.zh:
难道你不知道自己拥有了什么吗？这是通往船—船—船长奈斯宝藏的路线图！她一生中积攒的每一块—块—块珠宝都在这里。

这些财富属于我们。一旦我们拥有它，我们就能名留青史。每一个恒星系都将畏惧黑—黑—黑针……而这史诗的第一篇章将属于你。难道我们还不够慷慨吗？
responses.en:
Don't you know what you have? This is the chart to K-k-kaptain Ness's treasure! Every k-k-kredit and jewel stashed throughout her lifetime.

Its wealth belongs to us. Once we have it, we will sing our names into history. Every system will come to fear the Black-k-k Needle... And the first note in the k-k-korus will be yours. Are we not generous?

label.en: We do not give up so easily.

responses.zh: 那就让我们高唱战歌吧！我会将你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]做成战利品，献给我的旨——指挥官。
responses.en: Then let us sing! I will make a trophy of your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] and present it as a gift to my k-k-kommander.

label.zh: 结束通讯并交战后，伊纳克斯的舰船被瘫痪
label.en: After closing communications and engaging, Captain Inax's ship is disabled

title.en: Captain Inax of the Black Needle

texts.zh:
一场难忘的战斗！你并不像看起来那样弱。我们已经低估了你两次，但不会再犯同样的错误。下次我们相遇，黑——黑针将不会手下留情。

不要把这当作警告，这是你的死刑判决。
texts.en:
A memorable battle! You aren't as weak-k-k as you seem. We have underestimated you twice, but no longer. The next time we meet, the Black-k-k Needle will not be holding back.

Do not treat this as a warning. It is a death sentence.

texts.zh:
根据我们的调查，我们认为星国图志的下一部分隐藏在[this.GetName]的早已沦为废墟的定居点中。

鉴于其他胶囊的结构十分坚固，我们可以假设它在最近的轰炸中留存下来。
texts.en:
Based on our investigation, we believe that the next piece of the Celestial Chart is hidden somewhere within the ruined settlement on [this.GetName].

Given the sturdy construction of the other capsules, we can assume that it has survived the recent bombardment.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]寻找星国图志第四块碎片的行动已圆满结束。我们在一座石雕上发现了嵌入其中的胶囊，雕像描绘的是一个来自现已灭绝的斯密吉卜集体组织的子个体。雕像上的铭文如下：

“献给我的忠诚船员：这是我对你的感谢。愿你的孤独长久而平静。”

一旦这最后一块碎片被破译，我们就可以继续寻找奈斯船长的宝藏。
texts.en:
Our search for the fourth piece of the Celestial Chart on [from.GetName] has concluded successfully. The capsule was found embedded within a stone statue of a drone from the now-extinct collective known as Smeegibb. The inscription on the statue reads as follows:

"To my loyal crewmate: a token of my appreciation. May your solitude be long and peaceful."

Once this final piece of the chart is decoded, we can continue our search for Captain Ness' treasure.

texts.zh: 从斯密吉卜定居点废墟中发掘出胶囊后，剩下的就是解密里面的数据，并完成星国图志。我们很快就会发现奈斯船长的踪迹尽头等待着我们的是什么。
texts.en: After extracting the capsule from the ruins of Smeegibb's settlement, all that remains is to decrypt the data inside and complete the Celestial Chart. We will soon discover what awaits us at the end of Captain Ness' trail.

texts.zh:
解码后，新的数据片段完成了我们的星国图志。各个节点上闪烁着光点，指示着我们沿途发现的中间目的地。然后，四盏灯同时闪烁，揭示了另一个隐藏的恒星系。

添加最后一块数据解锁了额外的功能。这份导航图不仅仅是一张简单的地图，它包含了奈斯船长收集的关于星系中失落财富和非法珍宝的信息。一些数据可能已经过期，但该设备可以有效地检测到我们所有恒星系中隐藏的宝藏。

此外，星图还包含了船长在其职业生涯中发现的每件珍宝的评估信息。这些详细的笔记解释了如何识别、评估和向潜在买家展示获得的贵重物品，以获得最大利润。重新激活设备将提供独特宝藏库的设计，使我们的殖民地能够利用船长的无与伦比的洞察力，为我们的宝藏增值。
texts.en:
Once decoded, the new data fragment completed our Celestial Chart. Points of light shone at various nodes indicating the interim destinations we have discovered along the way. The four lights then flickered in unison before revealing another hidden system.

Adding the final piece of the data has unlocked additional capabilities. The Chart is not a simple map, it contains information on lost riches and illicit treasure troves across the galaxy as collected by Captain Ness. Some of the data may have expired, but this device can feasibly detect hidden caches of valuable treasure across all of our systems.

Furthermore, the Chart contains appraisal information on every treasure the Captain discovered throughout her career. These detailed notes explain how to identify, appraise, and present acquired valuables to potential sellers for maximum profit. Reactivating the device will provide designs for a unique Treasure Vault allowing our colonies to take advantage of the Captain's unparalleled insight and add value to our hoard.

label.zh: 《星国图志》完成后：激活该遗珍，建立珍宝馆
label.en: Once the chart is complete: activate the Celestial Chart relic to establish a treasure world

label.zh: 《星国图志》完成后每五年检查：0–360天后发现珍宝藏库（定居帝国）
label.en: Checked every five years once the chart is complete: a trove is found 0-360 days later (settled empires)

label.zh: 《星国图志》完成后每五年检查：0–360天后发现珍宝藏库（游牧帝国）
label.en: Checked every five years once the chart is complete: a trove is found 0-360 days later (nomads)

texts.zh: 星国图志为我们提供了宝贵的评估信息档案，有助于我们从发现的宝藏中提取更大的价值。我们应该在我们的一个殖民地上建立一座珍宝馆，用于对珍贵的小物件进行分类、修复和保存。根据目前的物流情况，以下殖民地适合建造这个新的设施。
texts.en: The Celestial Chart has provided us with archived appraisal information useful for extracting greater value from the treasures we discover. We should establish a Treasure Vault on one of our colonies where valuable trinkets can be sorted, restored, and preserved. Based on current logistics, the following colonies are suitable for this new installation.

texts.zh:
随着[from.GetName]上的珍宝馆的建立，我们相信星国图志有潜力为我们的经济做出重大贡献。

为了充分利用星图的能力，我们设立了一个新的内阁职位，专门负责领导我们发现和收集宝藏的行动。
texts.en:
With the establishment of the Treasure Vault on [from.GetName], we believe that the Celestial Chart has the potential to contribute significantly to our economy.

In order to best take advantage of the Chart's capabilities, we have conceived a new Council position for an individual to lead our efforts in discovering and gathering treasure.

notes.en: Review note: shown once (Galactic Paragons required), 5 days after the first treasure world (5015) or the first recovered trove (6015); its text depends on which came first.

texts.zh:
星国图志的完成对于[this.GetName]来说是一个重大的时刻。随着所有秘密的解开，我们被指引到一个无从回避的目的地：[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]星系。

在克服了许多障碍之后，我们只差一步之遥。只有一个问题仍然存在：星图的尽头是什么？

我们无法保证一定可以马到成功，但我们也决不容许其他人趁机夺取。让我们奋勇前进，完成这场冒险！
texts.en:
The completion of the Celestial Chart is a momentous occasion for [this.GetName]. With all its secrets unlocked, we are pointed to one inescapable destination: the [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName] system.

After overcoming many obstacles, we are but one step away. Only one question remains: what lies at the end of the Chart?

There is no guarantee of success, but we would not have it any other way. Let us strike forth to see this adventure through!

label.zh: 舰船首次进入星图标出的星门星系
label.en: A ship first enters the gateway system marked on the chart

texts.zh:
地图将我们带到一个以前未探明的黑洞，以及一个被虚空虫寄生的恒星系。它们在附近一座废弃的星门安家，其中最大的几只像守护者一样绕着这处废弃的建筑盘旋。

这一定就是通往我们梦寐以求宝藏的那道星门。如果我们要到达路线的终点，必须消灭虚空虫并修复星门。
texts.en:
The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with Voidworms. Having taken up nest in a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.

It must be this Gateway that will lead us to our long-sought treasure. If we are to reach the trail's end, we must eliminate the Voidworms and repair the Gate.

texts.zh:
地图将我们带到一个以前未探明到的黑洞，以及一个充满奇怪生物的恒星系。这些生物聚集在一个废弃星门的附近，其中最大的生物绕着这个废弃的结构盘旋，仿佛占领了此处。

这些巨大的虫状生物不在我们关于太空兽群的数据库中。我们目前正在尝试建立通信。这一定就是通往我们梦寐以求宝藏的那道星门。如果我们要到达轨迹的尽头，我们必须处理这些生物并修复星门。
texts.en:
The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with strange creatures. Having gathered around a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.

These massive worm-like entities are not present in our databases of spaceborne fauna. We are currently attempting to establish communications. It must be this Gateway that will lead us to our long-sought treasure. If we are to reach the trail's end, we must deal with these creatures and repair the Gate.

label.zh: 什么都不能挡我们的道。
label.en: Nothing will stand in our way.

label.zh: 如果我们必须这样做的话。

texts.zh: 我们按照星国图志指引，来到了[this.solar_system.GetName]星系中一个被虫群寄生的星门。必须先处理这些生物，才能重新激活星门，看看另一边有什么。
texts.en: We have followed the Celestial Chart to an infested Gateway in the [this.solar_system.GetName] system. These creatures must be dealt with before we can reactivate the Gate and see what is on the other side.

label.en: After defeating the gateway voidworms, without Gateway Activation technology

label.en: After defeating the gateway voidworms, with activation technology and the target gateway already restored

label.en: After completing research into Gateway Activation

texts.zh:
研究完必要的技术之后，我们现在可以重新激活位于[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]的古老星门。

一旦我们重新建立了系统之间的连接，地图就到此为止了。这张星图所隐藏的秘密很快就会揭晓。
texts.en:
After researching the appropriate technology, we are now able to reactivate the ancient Gateway in [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName].

Once we have re-established the link between the systems, the map goes no further. Whatever secrets this chart holds will soon be revealed.

Once we have re-established the link between the systems, the map goes no further. Whatever secrets this chart holds will soon be revealed.

texts.zh: 作为星国图志上的最终目的地，[this.solar_system.GetName]中的休眠星门可能是通往某个非常重要的地点。
texts.en: As the final destination on the Celestial Chart, the inactive Gateway in [this.solar_system.GetName] likely leads to something of great importance.

label.en: After the nomadic activation project and gateway upgrade complete

texts.zh: 作为星国图志上的最终目的地，[this.solar_system.GetName]中的休眠星门可能是通往某个非常重要的地点。
texts.en: As the final destination on the Celestial Chart, the inactive Gateway in [this.solar_system.GetName] likely leads to something of great importance.

label.zh: 完成对应星门的修复建造后
label.en: After completing restoration of the marked gateway

texts.zh:
在激活了星国图志路径终点处的星门后，我们发现了[ness_treasure_system.GetName]系统。天体的分布与我们在奈斯船长的航行日志中找到的草图相符。

我们的漫长旅程即将结束。
texts.en:
Having activated the Gateway at the end of the Celestial Chart, we have revealed the [ness_treasure_system.GetName] system. The distribution of celestial bodies matches sketches we found in Captain Ness's logbook.

Our long journey is almost at an end.

label.zh: 穿过星门，舰船首次进入藏宝星系
label.en: Travel through the gateway and first enter the treasure system

texts.zh:
我们被跟踪了。

现在，我们在[ness_treasure_system.GetName]遭遇了一支强大的黑针舰队。与我们上次遭遇相比，他们的队伍规模显著扩大，包括退役的军舰和改装了高级武器的民用船只。看来他们已经集结了大部分预备舰队来应对这次对抗。舰队中央是他们的旗舰，一艘巨大的泰坦级战舰。

虽然他们的编队已做好战斗准备，但大多数舰船尚未启动武器。看来他们打算谈判。

我们正在接收来自旗舰的通讯。
texts.en:
We were followed.

We are now confronted by an imposing Black Needle fleet in [ness_treasure_system.GetName]. In comparison to our last encounter, their ranks have swelled significantly to include decommissioned military ships and civilian vessels retrofitted with high-grade armaments. It appears that they have assembled the bulk of their reserve fleets for this confrontation. At the center of the fleet lies their flagship, a massive Titan class vessel.

While their formation is battle-ready, most ships have not yet primed their weapons. It seems they intend to negotiate.

We are receiving a transmission from the flagship.

title.en: Cobalt Quill, Captain of the Black Needle

texts.zh:
尽管身材矮小，这位海盗船长却散发着威严。他的眼睛在盘算着，仿佛在解一道复杂的方程式，将我们仔细评估。

终于见面了。钴羽，黑针号船长，我们家族的荣耀，也是银羽创始人的后裔，向您致敬！您多年来一直是我们的一根刺——但我还是讲道理的。我带着一个提议而来。

我们会为您的完整星图支付丰厚的赏金，并允许您带着你们无足轻重的性命离开。

如果您拒绝，我们将别无选择，只能强行夺取我们想要的东西。我们的海军实力占优，并且我们也渗透了您帝国的所有关键设施。只要我一声令下，您就会彻底崩溃。
texts.en:
Despite his small stature, this pirate captain emanates gravitas. His eyes are calculating, weighing us up as if part of a complex equation.

At last we finally meet. Cobalt Quill at your service; Captain of the illustrious Black Needle and humble descendant of our founder, Silver Quill. You have been a thorn in my side for a great many years - but I'm reasonable if nothing else. I come to you with an offer.

We will give you a significant bounty for your completed chart and allow you to leave with your meaningless lives intact.

If you refuse, we will have no choice but to take what we want by force. Our naval superiority notwithstanding, we have also infiltrated every place you hold dear. A single command of mine is all that keeps you from total ruin.

responses.zh:
尽管你造成了诸多困扰，但我愿意提供丰厚的赏金，以换取奈斯船长完整的遗物。

如果你接受这份慷慨的提议，我准备原谅你过去的所有过失。我们之间没有必要继续这场冲突。或者升级……
responses.en:
Despite the frustrations you have caused, I am willing to provide a significant bounty in exchange for Captain Ness's completed relic.

If you accept this generous offer, I am prepared to forgive all past misdeeds. There is no need for this conflict between us to continue. Or escalate...

responses.zh:
关于[this.GetName]，我无所不知。你的供应链、资源库的位置、空间站的分布，一切都记录得清清楚楚。

我一直在关注你们领导层中的每一位值得信赖的个人，以及他们的亲人……

我的人已经进行了研究，我完全清楚如何瓦解你的帝国。我会让你的人民陷入饥荒，偷走你的补给，并摧毁剩余的一切。当然，这取决于你是否愿意给我想要的东西……
responses.en:
I know everything there is to know about [this.GetName]. Your supply chains, the location of your resource silos, the distribution of your stations: everything is meticulously accounted for.

I have eyes on every trusted individual within your leadership, as well as their loved ones...

My people have done the research, and I know exactly how to take you apart. I will starve your people, steal your supplies, and destroy whatever remains. That is, of course, unless you give me what I want...

responses.zh:
关于[this.GetName]，我无所不知。你的供应链、资源库的位置、空间站的分布，一切都记录得清清楚楚。

我正在跟踪你们集体中的每个主要节点，并在新节点创建时接收到通知。

我的人已经进行了研究，我完全清楚如何瓦解你的帝国。我会让你的人民陷入饥荒，偷走你的补给，并摧毁剩余的一切。当然，这取决于你是否愿意给我想要的东西……
responses.en:
I know everything there is to know about [this.GetName]. Your supply chains, the location of your resource silos, the distribution of your stations: everything is meticulously accounted for.

I am tracking every major node within your collective and are alerted whenever a new one is created.

My people have done the research, and I know exactly how to take you apart. I will starve your people, steal your supplies, and destroy whatever remains. That is, of course, unless you give me what I want...

responses.zh:
关于[this.GetName]，我无所不知。你的供应链、资源库的位置、空间站的分布，一切都记录得清清楚楚。

我已经侵入了你的位置矩阵，能够追踪你网络中每个主要节点的位置。

我的人已经进行了研究，我完全清楚如何瓦解你的帝国。我会让你的人民陷入饥荒，偷走你的补给，并摧毁剩余的一切。当然，这取决于你是否愿意给我想要的东西……
responses.en:
I know everything there is to know about [this.GetName]. Your supply chains, the location of your resource silos, the distribution of your stations: everything is meticulously accounted for.

I have a backdoor into your location matrix, tracking the position of every principal node in your network.

My people have done the research, and I know exactly how to take you apart. I will starve your people, steal your supplies, and destroy whatever remains. That is, of course, unless you give me what I want...

label.zh: 何必多此一举和我们谈判？

responses.zh:
这种规模的破坏行动可不便宜。船舶维护、工资、贿赂，这些东西都很昂贵，大手大脚花钱可不会带来暴富。等待你们的毁灭规模巨大，按下开关就能实现，这其中有很大的机会成本。

有更好的地方可以花我的辛苦赚来的钱。来吧，让我们避免更多无谓的流血。拿着你们新获得的财富，离开这里，让专业人士来做海盗。
responses.en:
A sabotage operation of this scale doesn't come cheap. Ship upkeep, wages, bribes; these things are expensive, and I didn't get rich by spending when I don't have to. There is a significant opportunity cost for the sheer scale of destruction that awaits you at the flip of a switch.

There are better ways to spend my hard-earned money. Come, let us avoid more meaningless bloodshed. Take your newfound wealth and leave the piracy to the experts.

label.zh: 这不仅仅是钱的问题，对吧？
label.en: This isn't just about the credits, is it?

responses.zh:
五千年前，我的祖先，伟大的银羽，是奈斯船长的副手。他忠心耿耿地为她服务多年，可最终得到了什么回报？

背叛！

她将他交给了当局，并独吞了赏金！当然，没有任何监狱能够囚禁强大的银羽。

在一次大胆的逃脱后，他从灰烬中崛起，将他的杂牌军锻造成如今站在你面前的传奇黑针。他发誓要报复背叛他的奈斯船长，将毕生精力投入到掠夺她的宝藏，并用自己的成功掩埋她的名声。

我只是在完成他的遗愿。这张星图是夺回我们应得之物的关键。

现在，请把它交出来。
responses.en:
5000 years ago my ancestor, the great Silver Quill, was the First Mate of Captain Ness. He gave her years of loyal service, and how was he repaid?

Betrayal!

She handed him over to the authorities and pocketed the bounty! But of course, no prison could contain the mighty Silver Quill.

After a daring escape, he rose from the proverbial ashes, forging his motley crew into the legendary Black Needle that stands before you today. Swearing revenge against the traitorous Captain Ness, he dedicated his life to looting her treasure and burying her legacy under the weight of his own success.

I am simply finishing what he started. This chart is the key to reclaiming what is rightfully ours.

Now please, hand it over.

texts.zh:
黑针的首领提出了一项提议，他们愿意支付巨额赏金来换取星国图志。如果我们接受了这个交易，就等于将奈斯船长宝藏的关键拱手相让。

拒绝他们的提议将会招致他们的怒火。这些海盗渗透到我们军队序列中的程度尚不清楚，但他们威胁要从内部彻底瓦解[this.GetName]。这些威胁是否只是虚张声势，还有待观察。
texts.en:
The leader of the Black Needle has made a proposition, offering us a significant bounty in exchange for the Celestial Chart. If we took this deal, we would be handing over the key to Captain Ness's treasure.

Rejecting this proposal will invoke their full wrath. The extent to which these pirates have infiltrated our ranks is unknown, but they have threatened to completely dismantle [this.GetName] from the inside out. Whether these are but empty threats remains to be seen.

texts.zh:
黑针发起了全面攻击，给我们带来影响广泛的混乱。生产线停产，发电机烧毁，重要的行政基础设施被迫下线。货物消失，研究站的数据被清空，矿井坍塌速度是正常速度的五倍。

这场全方位的破坏是数千名歹毒的参与者协同作案的结果。一个庞大的破坏者网络潜伏在我们之中，他们似乎总是领先我们一步。
texts.en:
The Black Needle has launched an all-out assault, unleashing widespread chaos. Assembly lines have ground to a halt, generators have burnt out, and essential administrative infrastructure has been taken offline. Shipments are disappearing, research stations have had their data wiped, and mines are collapsing at five times the typical rate.

The devastation is total; the result of insidious handiwork of thousands of malevolent actors working in tandem. A vast network of saboteurs is hidden among us and they seem to be one step ahead of us.

texts.zh: 来自黑针的大量破坏分子潜伏在我们之中，在[owner.GetName]各地造成广泛破坏。除非我们消灭这些破坏分子，否则破坏将持续下去，直到我们的补给线崩溃。
texts.en: A vast network of saboteurs from the Black Needle is hidden among us causing widespread disruption across [owner.GetName]. Unless we eliminate the saboteurs, the damage will continue until our supply lines collapse.

label.zh: 军事解决：局势进行中击败对应黑针主舰队（普通袭击舰队不计）
label.en: Defeat the associated Black Needle main fleet during the situation (raiding fleets do not count)

label.zh: 应对进度达到100且存在非统治者、非继承人、非节点领袖
label.en: At progress 100, with a leader who is not a ruler, heir or gestalt node

texts.zh: 尽管黑针竭尽全力破坏我们的基础设施，我们依然得到恢复并稳定了局势。他们的特工已被击败，剩下的就是与他们在[hoard_system.GetName]集结的舰队对抗，并以[root.GetName]的名义夺取奈斯船长的宝藏。
texts.en: Despite the extensive efforts of the Black Needle to sabotage our infrastructure, we have recovered and stabilized. With their agents defeated, all that remains is to confront their amassed fleet in [hoard_system.GetName] and claim Captain Ness's Hoard in the name of [root.GetName].

title.en: Last Stand of the Black Needle

texts.zh: 在对[root.GetName]的恒星系进行大规模破坏性攻击后，黑针仍然维持着对奈斯船长的宝藏的封锁。他们已经耗尽了大部分资源，现在处于脆弱状态。如果我们在这里击败他们，他们的整个组织必然会崩溃，让我们可以自由地夺取宝藏。
texts.en: Following extensive sabotage attacks on [root.GetName] systems, the Black Needle have maintained their blockade around Captain Ness's Hoard. They have exhausted much of their resources, and are now in a vulnerable position. If we defeat them here, their wider organization will surely crumble, allowing us to freely claim the treasure.

texts.zh:
不幸的是，我们无法阻止黑针的破坏行动。他们的破坏者已经彻底破坏了我们的后勤基础设施，重建供应链将需要数年时间。他们在我们的恒星系中传播的腐败规模太大，无法得到缓解。

然而，这不会阻止我们以我们的名义夺取奈斯船长的宝藏。我们只需要在战斗中击败海盗，宝藏就会属于我们。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, we were unable to thwart the devastating operations of Black Needle. Their saboteurs have damaged our logistics infrastructure beyond repair, and it will take many years to rebuild our supply chains. The corruption they've spread throughout our systems is on too grand of a scale to be mitigated.

However, this will not stop us from claiming Captain Ness's Hoard in our name. All that we must do is defeat the pirates in battle, and the treasure will be ours.

texts.zh: 黑针的军力根本无法与我们强大的军队抗衡。他们集结的舰队已被击败，无法再支持对我们恒星系的破坏行动。现在，我们可以在[root.GetName]的名义下夺取奈斯船长的宝藏。
texts.en: The Black Needle could simply not compete with the might of our military. With their amassed fleets defeated, they can no longer support the sabotage efforts within our systems. We are now free to claim Captain Ness's Hoard in the name of [root.GetName].

title.en: Cobalt Quill, Captain of the Black Needle

texts.zh:
奈斯的孩子们……真是讽刺。

是她选择了你——你知道吗？

数百种物种任她挑选……她却选择了你。也许她看到了你身上的特别之处，也许这只是一场纯粹的偶然。无论如何，我们都走到了这一步。

你赢了……暂时。不要轻视这场胜利。你已经树立了强大的敌人——我们，黑针我们不会宽恕，也不会忘记。

就像我的祖先一样，我们会坚持下去。我们会一点一点地重建我们失去的一切。即使需要一千年，一百万年——我们也会回来，夺回你从我们手中夺走的一切。

黑针将永远存在！永远！
texts.en:
Ness's children... how ironic.

She chose you - do you know that?

Hundreds of species to choose from... and she chose you. Maybe she saw something special in you, or maybe it was complete chance. Either way, here we are.

You win... for now. Do not dare take this victory lightly. You have made a powerful enemy in us. The Black Needle does not forgive, and we do not forget.

As my ancestors did before me, we will persevere. We will rebuild what we have lost piece by piece. Even if it takes a thousand years, a million years - we will return and reclaim everything you have stolen from us.

The Black Needle will live on forever! Forever!

texts.zh:
奈斯船长的宝藏近在咫尺了。

尽管它看起来被遗弃了，但建筑物的许多系统仍在运行。考虑到奈斯船长的传说性质，我们应该警惕预料之外的安全措施。

这个宝库的唯一入口在其中央舱口处有一个凹槽。我们可以将星国图志插入这里，打开这个神秘的设施。
texts.en:
Captain Ness's Hoard is ours to take.

Despite its abandoned appearance, many of the building's systems are active. Given the alleged nature of Captain Ness, we should be cautious of unexpected security measures.

The singular entrance of the treasure trove has an indent carved into its central hatch. We can insert the Celestial Chart here to open this mysterious facility.

texts.zh:
星国图志是钥匙，而宝库是它的锁。我们把它插入巨型结构的主舱口。

星图启动，内部追踪着一道单一的的光束，指向我们旅程中经过的每一颗恒星。古老的机器发出咯吱咯吱的响声，我们很快便进入了内部。

来自一千个世界的难以置信的宝藏，在地板和墙壁上堆积如山。精致的雕像与用贵金属打造的攻击武器并列。精美的珠宝悬挂在古老化石的末端，复杂的装置堆积成一堆，毫无秩序。

金属的脚步声从中央走道传来。一只充满液体的类人生物机器，举起双臂投降，向我们走来。它的语音电路发出噼啪声，启动了：

“所以……你最终还是找到了我的星图。你真聪明。”
texts.en:
The Celestial Chart was a key, and the vault was its lock. We inserted it into the main hatch of the megastructure.

The chart activated, internally tracing a singular beam of light to each star along our journey. Ancient machinery groaned to life, and we were soon inside.

Incredible treasures looted from a thousand worlds line the floor and walls in abundance. Delicate statues are juxtaposed against assault weapons forged in precious metals. Fine jewelry hangs from the extremities of antique fossils and complex devices are piled up in an orderless heap.

Metallic footsteps ring out from the central walkway. Arms raised in surrender, a fluid-filled humanoid machine approaches us. Its voice circuits crackle into activation:

"So... you found my chart after all. Aren't you clever?"

texts.zh:
尽管她的机械形态限制了其表达能力，但被称为奈斯船长的机器却用一种自鸣得意的眼神看着我们。她的金属身体没有丝毫磨损的迹象，仿佛刚组装不久。她的语气既耐心又居高临下，仿佛在对一个地位低于她的人说话。

我想应该做个自我介绍，尽管你可能已经猜到我是谁了。

我叫桑达·奈斯，或者至少以前是。曾经的“星海海盗女王”，现在是这堆冰冷螺栓的主人。

机器停顿了一下，观察着我们的形态。

我已经很久没有见过你们这种生物了。看起来你们这些原始人已经长大成人了！

我必须说，我对你们能来到这里感到非常惊讶。
texts.en:
Despite the limited expressions available in her robotic form, the machine known as Captain Ness regards us with a certain smugness. Her metallic body shows no sign of wear and tear, as if only recently assembled. Her tone is patient yet patronizing, as if addressing one below her status.

I suppose some introduction is in order, though you may already have guessed who I am.

The name's Saanda Ness, or at least it was. Former "Pirate Queen of the Galaxy" and current occupant of this cold pile of bolts.

The machine pauses for a moment, taking in our forms.

It's been a long time since I last saw your species. Looks like you primitives are all grown up!

I must say, I'm quite impressed you've made it here.

responses.zh:
永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了[fallen_empire.GetRealName]的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。

机器启动了一个控制台，露出墙上隐藏的一个密室。一个古老的冷冻舱里，躺着一位有机生物的遗骸。

我在这里。一个无用的装饰品，但我有点怀旧。我看起来不错，对吧？

我确认一切就绪后，锁上了这个保险库，然后休眠了几千年。下一件事，你就打开了门，我们现在正在进行这场对话。感觉就像昨天我躺下睡觉一样……
responses.en:
Immortality doesn't come cheap. I paid some scientists from [fallen_empire.GetRealName] a few million credits to transfer my consciousness without raising the alarm. They did a fair job, but I can't dance as well as I used to.

The machine activates a console, revealing a chamber hidden in the wall. Within an ancient cryo-pod are the remains of an organic being.

Here I am. A useless ornament, but I'm a bit sentimental. Looked good, didn't I?

Once I checked that everything was in place, I locked up this vault and powered down for a few thousand years. Next thing I know, you've opened the door and we're having this conversation. Feels like only yesterday I laid down to sleep...

responses.zh:
永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了策展人组织的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。

label.zh: 你这些宝藏是从哪里来的？
label.en: Where did you get all of this treasure?

responses.zh:
大部分都是偷来的，或者用其他不义之财换来的。我曾经从星海的所有大人物那里偷过东西。货船、巨像武器，你随便说，我都劫持过。我的逻辑是，如果我能这么容易地从你那里拿走东西，说明你根本不在乎，不配拥有它。

有时候事情会变得……很糟糕。你看到了乙特人发生了什么。那件事让我大开眼界。

玩玩闹闹，直到不再有趣……
responses.en:
Stole it, mostly. Or traded it for other ill-gotten goods. I ripped off every major player in the galaxy once upon a time. Cargo ships, Colossus weapons; you name it, I've hijacked it. My logic was that if I could take something so easily from you, you didn't care enough to deserve it.

Things would sometimes get... messy. You saw what happened to the Ytterites. That one was an eye-opener.

It's all fun and games until it's not any more...

responses.zh:
如果说是因为我孤独，你会相信吗？

机器的语音电路发出应该称之为笑声的咯咯声。

我拥有了所有这些财富，但为了什么？最终能给我带来什么？我意识到我想要的不是财富，而是传承。但是，你无法偷走传承——那么如何创造一个呢？

好吧，我是这么打算的。我找到了几个最有希望的原始物种，并在他们的世界中播下了宝藏——当然还有地图。第一个拼凑出我的藏宝图的人将通过考验，并有资格继承我毕生的基业。于是……我们就在这里碰面了。

也许你们一族能做到我做不到的事情，并将所有这些付诸实践。
responses.en:
Would you believe me if I said I was lonely?

The machine's vocal circuits crackled with what might have been laughter.

I had all of this treasure, but for what? What does it get me in the end? I realized it wasn't riches that I wanted; it was a legacy. But, you can't steal a legacy - so how do you create one?

Well, this was my shot at it. I found a few of the most promising primitive species and seeded their worlds with treasure - and the map of course. Whoever pieced together my chart first would pass the test and be worthy of inheriting my life's work. So... here we are.

Maybe your kind can do what I could not, and put all of this to good use.

responses.zh:
我已经告诉过你们，我要把火炬传下去。我并不擅长花钱，只会赚钱。

不过，我不能把钱随便给任何人。他们必须足够聪明才能来到这里；一支我能为之骄傲的队伍。一支我能与之分享我的故事的队伍……
responses.en:
I've told you, I'm passing on the torch. I'm not good at spending money, only taking it.

I couldn't give it away to just anyone, though. They had to be clever enough to reach this place; a crew I could be proud of. One I could share my story with...

responses.zh:
好吧，既然你诚心诚意地发问了……

机器启动了一个控制台，一系列数字记录被投射到墙上。

整个藏宝库都是我的自传。我花了很多钱雇佣了一支作家团队，记录下我生命中所有可以记住的时刻。我认为他们做得还不错。

图像切换到一个海盗船员的驾驶舱画面，船长奈斯的生物形态在指挥。机器的语音电路发出一声短暂的噼啪声；那是一声叹息。

我曾经是星系中最令人恐惧的海盗。我让大型企业破产，勒索星球，并将整个帝国夷为平地。任何愚蠢到敢于反对我的人，要么被我的[root.GetSpeciesOrganName]刺穿，要么被卖掉换取赏金。我自己的赏金？天文数字。
responses.en:
Well, since you asked...

The machine activates a console, and a series of digital recordings are projected across the wall.

This entire vault is my biography. I paid a great deal to a team of authors to record every moment of my life that could be remembered. They did a fair job of it, I think.

The images shift to a cockpit image of a pirate crew, the biological form of Captain Ness in command. A short crackle escapes the machine's voice circuits; it has the weight of a sigh.

I was once the most feared pirate in the galaxy. I've bankrupted mega-corporations, ransomed planets, and reduced entire empires to rubble. Anyone foolish enough to oppose me got a blade in their [root.GetSpeciesOrganName] or were sold off for a bounty. My own bounty? Astronomical.

responses.zh:
各种抢劫、盗窃和惊险逃脱的数字记录，伴随着史诗音乐的投影，在屏幕上播放。

起初，我精心挑选目标，并为自己的行为寻找正当理由，认为他们罪有应得。每一次行动都比上一次更刺激。这是一个循环：计划、妖魔化、抢劫、然后庆祝。问题是寻找“坏”目标太耗时了。我需要拓宽视野。

最终，如果我想要什么，我就直接拿走。我喜欢看着数字上涨，我的战利品的价值和我的宝藏的价值。我在世界上留下了自己的印记，我将永远不会被遗忘。其他一切都不重要。
responses.en:
Digital recordings of various hold-ups, heists, and daring escapes, all set to heroic music are projected.

At first, I picked my targets carefully and found some justification as to why they deserved it. Each job was more exciting than the last. It was a cycle: planning, demonizing, robbing, then celebrating. The problem was that looking for "bad" targets was too time-consuming. I needed to expand my horizons.

Eventually, if there was something I wanted, I'd just take it. I enjoyed watching the numbers go up; the price of my bounty and the value of my hoard. I was leaving my mark on the world and I'd never be forgotten. Everything else was unimportant.

responses.zh:
乙特人的家园已经成为一片废墟。

然后，乙特星事件发生了……你看到了吧？我还记得广播里传来的哭喊声，那是他们最后生命的消逝。事情已经走得太远了。是时候改变了。

在我的职业生涯中，我发现了一个规律：历史会淡忘，教训会被遗忘，总会有新人来接替你的位置。我只是想选择接替我的人。

那就是你。你们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]通过了考验。接下来会发生什么，就取决于你了。
responses.en:
The Ytterite homeworld is displayed in ruin.

Then the Yterrite incident happened... You saw it, right? I still remember the cries on the radio as the last of their lives were snuffed out. Things went too far. It was time for a change.

There was a pattern I discovered over my career: History fades, lessons are forgotten, and someone new takes your place. I simply wanted to be able to pick who came after me.

That's you. You [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] passed the test. What happens next is up to you.

texts.zh:
奈斯船长的宝藏包含着难以置信的财富。然而，我们必须考虑以我们的名义宣称它所带来的后果。

她宝藏中的每一笔信用都是非法获得的。获取这些资源将意味着我们容忍奈斯船长的过度犯罪行为，以换取物质财富。

话虽如此，许多被奈斯船长伤害的人早已不在人世。宣称这笔财富不会造成新的受害者。此外，我们已经消灭了黑针，从而使星系变得更加安全。经过漫长的危险旅程，我们理所当然地应该得到丰厚的回报。

我们必须决定如何处理它。
texts.en:
Captain Ness's Hoard contains an incredible bounty of wealth. We must however consider the consequences of claiming it in our name.

Every credit of her treasure was earned illegally. Taking these resources would represent a tolerance of Captain Ness's excessive criminality in exchange for material wealth.

That said, many of those wronged by Captain Ness are long gone. Claiming this wealth would create no new victims. Furthermore, we have decimated the Black Needle and thus made the galaxy a safer place. Having traveled this long path fraught with danger, we arguably deserve a sizable reward for our efforts.

We must make a decision on what to do with its contents.

texts.zh:
奈斯船长的宝藏是终极的藏宝地，我们很高兴能获得它的战利品。

这是打败了黑针的应得奖励——为[this.GetName]三呼万岁！

让我们清理这个金库。所有[This.Species.GetHandNamePlural]准备就位！
texts.en:
Captain Ness's Hoard is the ultimate treasure trove, and we are pleased to claim its booty.

A hard-earned reward for taking down the Black Needle - three cheers for [this.GetName]!

Let's clear out this vault. All [This.Species.GetHandNamePlural] on deck!

texts.zh:
现在被称为奈斯船长的机器对我们清空她的珍宝库的速度印象深刻。

去吧，你应得的。这笔财富里包含着许多血汗和泪水。别在一个地方花光了。
texts.en:
The machine now known as Captain Ness was impressed at how quickly we emptied her vault.

Go ahead, you deserve it. There's a lot of blood, sweat, and tears in this treasure. Don't spend it all in one place.

texts.zh:
现在被称为奈斯船长的机器对我们想要归还她辛苦赚来的宝藏感到不安。

真是令人失望。所以某个第十五代继承人会得到他们祖先的旧首饰。好吧，希望你们能把剩下的东西用在更有价值的项目上。尽管你们最近干了些蠢事，但我相信你们会把这件事做好。
texts.en:
The machine now known as Captain Ness was perturbed at our desire to repatriate some of her hard-earned treasure.

How disappointing. So some fifteenth-generation heirling will get their ancestor's old jewelry. Well, hopefully you'll use whatever's left on a worthier project. Despite recent evidence, I trust you to get this right.

texts.zh:
现在被称为奈斯船长的机器得知我们要把她的全部积蓄都送出去，感到十分厌恶。

这就是你的计划？免费送给所有人？他们做了什么值得得到这些？真是浪费！

我对你原本抱有更高的期望……至少让我指挥一些你的舰队，让我可以再试一次曾经的海盗生涯。
texts.en:
The machine now known as Captain Ness was disgusted when she learned that we would be giving away her entire hoard.

This is your master plan? Free stuff for everyone? What did they do to deserve any of it? What a waste!

I thought better of you... at least give me command of some of your fleets so I can try this all over again.

texts.zh: 现在的问题是该如何处理奈斯船长本人。作为一名经验丰富的舰船驾驶员，她经历过无数危险遭遇，将成为我们军队中优秀的指挥官。或者，她也可以在我们队伍中担任更具保障性的角色，培训下一代飞行员。
texts.en: The question remains of what to do with Captain Ness herself. As an experienced pilot who has survived a multitude of dangerous encounters, she would be an excellent asset to our military as a Commander. Alternatively, she could take a more supporting role within our ranks to train our next generation of pilots.

texts.zh: 或者我们也可以她关起来，以此向我们的公民表明，任何罪行都不会逍遥法外。她将有足够的时间反思自己的所作所为。
texts.en: That is unless we simply incarcerate her to set an example to our citizens that no crime goes unpunished. She would have a long time to think about what she's done.

texts.zh:
唯一剩下的决定是关于奈斯船长本人。作为一名强大的独立思想者，她可以成为一名独特的指挥官，提供出敌不意的创意策略。或者，我们可以将她的丰富战斗经验融入我们的集体知识中，并利用它来进一步加深我们对战争的理解。

或者我们也可以干脆将她囚禁起来，以表明在[this.GetName]中不容忍背叛和犯罪行为。
texts.en:
The only remaining decision is to do with Captain Ness herself. As a powerful independent mind, she would make for a unique asset in a Commander role, offering creative strategies that could catch opponents off-guard. Alternatively, we could integrate her vast combat experience into our collective knowledge and use it to further our wider understanding of warfare.

That is unless we simply imprison her to make it clear that deviance and criminality are not to be tolerated within [this.GetName].

label.en: We will integrate your knowledge into our consciousness.

texts.zh:
你这个脑袋空空的傻屌！我给你整个世界，你却只给我一副新的镣铐？你不配得到我给你的东西！你甚至不配为我擦靴子！

愿这[this.GetName]上留下一块黑斑，诅咒你们所有人！

愿你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]在虚空中枯萎，愿你们的名字被人遗忘。
texts.en:
You empty-minded echo! I offer you the world and all I get is a fresh pair of cuffs? You don't deserve what I've given you! You don't deserve to clean my boots!

A black spot on the [this.GetName], a curse upon you all!

May your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] wither in the void and and your name be forgotten.

名为奈斯船长的机器俘虏被发现在她的牢房里停机。我们相信她故意导致了电路的严重故障，关闭了关键系统，并从她转移的意识中删除了所有存储的数据。在她牢房的墙壁上发现了一条潦草的留言：

与你同归于尽……
texts.en:
The captive machine known as Captain Ness was found deactivated in her cell. We believe that she had purposely caused a critical malfunction in her circuits, shutting down crucial systems and erasing all stored data from her transferred consciousness. A message was found scribbled on her cell walls:

To the void with you...

就这样了？

你只是把我抛弃了？

真令人失望……我想我该走了。

祝你好运，我想。
texts.en:
That's it, then?

You're just casting me aside?

How disappointing... I guess I'll be on my way.

Good luck out there, I guess.

他们会怎样讲述这段冒险故事！我们发现了奈斯船长的隐藏宝藏，没有人能阻挡我们。

现在是时候开创自己的命运了。没有星图可循，星辰将成为我们的指引。

我们将取得什么成就？我们将如何被铭记？

高高地挂起[this.GetName]的旗帜，现在我们的故事才真正开始！
texts.en:
What tales they will tell of this adventure! We discovered the hidden treasure of Captain Ness and let no crew stand in our way.

Now it is time to forge our own destiny. With no chart left to follow, the stars themselves will be our guide.

What will we achieve? How will we be remembered?

Mount the jack of [this.GetName] high and proud. Now our story truly begins!

texts.zh:

现在是时候开创自己的命运了。没有星图可循，星辰将成为我们的指引。

我们将取得什么成就？我们将如何被铭记？

This adventure has come to an end. The quest for the Treasure of Captain Ness is complete.

Now it is time to forge our own destiny. With no chart left to follow, the stars themselves will be our guide.

What will we achieve? How will we be remembered?

This is where the story of [this.GetName] truly begins.

texts.zh:
我们截获了黑针在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。

他们的特工一直秘密地在我们的操作系统中传播恶意软件，制造了一个由叛乱单位构成的休眠军队，潜伏在我们系统各个位置。

这个歹毒的重新编程计划已经走得如此之远，以至于腐化了[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]。
texts.en:
We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the Black Needle throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

Their operatives have been covertly spreading insidious malware within our operating systems, creating a sleeper army of rebel units occupying various positions across our systems.

The malicious reprogramming scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], [traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们截获了黑针在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。

他们的特工一直在居住地释放分离性信息素，导致我们许多工蜂产生了潜在的偏差。一旦被迷惑住，海盗们将我们的工蜂重新安置到休眠特工的舱室，他们目前正在破坏我们的基础设施。

这个庞大的计划已经发展到腐蚀[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]。
texts.en:
We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the Black Needle throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

Their operatives have been flooding habitats with dissociative pheromones, causing many of our drones to develop an underlying deviance. Once disillusioned, the pirates reorganized our drones into pods of sleeper agents who are currently tearing down our infrastructure.

The extensive scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], [traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们截获了黑针在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。

我们已经得知他们的特工多年来一直在招募心怀不满的公民，为这次大规模袭击做准备，他们利用潜伏的间谍网络和各种随时准备背叛我们的线人。

其中一名叛徒已暴露，正是[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]，这构成了重大的安全风险。我们必须处理这个阴谋家，同时保持一定程度的稳定。公众得知这种程度的腐败将对我们的政府造成严重后果。
texts.en:
We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the Black Needle throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

We have learned their operatives have been recruiting disgruntled citizens for years, preparing for this extensive attack with sleeper cells and a variety of assets ready to turn against us.

One of the traitors has been revealed to be [traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName], which presents a considerable security risk. We must deal with this conspirator while maintaining some sense of stability. Public knowledge of this level of corruption would have serious repercussions for our government.

texts.zh:
我们以一笔巨额能量币和一艘名为针眼的非凡军舰作为报酬，给出了星国图志。我们可以认为我们与黑针的争端已彻底解决。

我们避免了与他们全部舰队进行重大交战，并阻止了一次对星系规模的蓄意破坏企图。

最好还是让海盗们继续做他们的海盗勾当。
texts.en:
We handed over the Celestial Chart in exchange for a large sum of Energy Credits and an exceptional military flagship known as The Eye of the Needle. We can consider our dispute with the Black Needle to be settled once and for all.

We have avoided a significant engagement with the full force of their fleets and prevented a sabotage attempt on a galactic scale.

Better that we simply leave piracy to the pirates.

note.en: The completed chart is handed over for energy and the Black Needle Eye; Ness's vault is marked as plundered and the main line does not continue.

texts.zh: [this.solar_system.GetName]星系中虚空虫的尸骸显示出异常读数。我们的扫描仪似乎在一个垂垂死去的三头虫中探测到生命迹象。我们应该派遣一艘科研船去进一步调查。
texts.en: The remains of the Voidworms in [this.solar_system.GetName] are showing unusual readings. Our scanners seem to detect signs of life within one of decaying Troikas. We should send a Science Ship to investigate this further.

texts.zh:
在一具虚空虫的尸体中，发现了一群刚刚孵化的若虫。尽管它们的同类遭受了屠戮，但它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始与我们的舰队并肩漂浮，以示恳求。

如果我们愿意，可以利用它们对我们的本能依恋：一旦成熟，这群太空生物将成为我们控制下的一支强大的有机舰队。
texts.en:
A clutch of nymphs were found nestled within one of the Voidworm carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.

If we so choose, we could use their instinctive attachment to our advantage: once matured, this clutch of spaceborne creatures could become an impressive organic fleet under our control.

texts.zh:
在一具蛇形生物的残骸中，发现了一窝幼崽。尽管它们的同类遭受了损失，它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始在我们的舰队旁边漂浮，以示臣服。

如果我们愿意，可以利用它们对我们的本能依恋：一旦成熟，这群太空生物将成为我们控制下的一支强大的有机舰队。
texts.en:
A clutch of younglings were found nestled within one of the serpentine carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.

If we so choose, we could use their instinctive attachment to our advantage: once matured, this clutch of spaceborne creatures could become an impressive organic fleet under our control.

texts.zh: 我们发现，这些远距离信号源于一种简单的太空生物，我们将其命名为“虚空虫”。似乎整个星系都充满了这种生物。根据信号的不同波长，我们确定这些生物在达到最终成熟之前会经历多个生长阶段。虽然它们表面上看起来并不具有攻击性，但它们的交流模式表明它们在星系范围内进行着协调。
texts.en: We have discovered that the far-reaching signals originate from a simple spaceborne organism we have taken to calling "Voidworms". It appears that the galaxy is riddled with these creatures. From the varying wavelengths of the signals, we have determined that the creatures develop through several stages of growth before reaching final maturity. Though they do not appear outwardly aggressive, their patterns of communication indicate coordination on a galactic scale.

由于这些漏洞暴露，海盗决定放弃他们在[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]上的基地，立即撤离并保护在那里储存的其他贵重物品。这颗可居住的卫星现在无人居住，可以被殖民。
texts.en:
Following our narrow escape from the Black Needle stronghold, the full extent of our infiltration efforts has been discovered.

With these vulnerabilities exposed, the pirates decided to abandon their base on [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], evacuating immediately and securing the other valuables that were stored there. This habitable moon is now unoccupied and can be colonized.

texts.zh:

由于这些漏洞暴露，海盗决定放弃他们在[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]上的基地，立即撤离并保护在那里储存的其他贵重物品。这颗可居住的卫星现在无人居住，可以被殖民。
texts.en:
The Black Needle have finally realized that they were duped, discovering the holes in their closed security network.

With these vulnerabilities exposed, the pirates decided to abandon their base on [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], evacuating immediately and securing the other valuables that were stored there. This habitable moon is now unoccupied and can be colonized.

texts.en: Unfortunately, one of the guards caught on to our scheme as we were loading the capsule onto the ship. The discovery led to a short firefight, as we were forced to flee the scene with the precious cargo in tow. The capsule was successfully extracted, but Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] killed in the crossfire.

战术顾问提醒，这种做法可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。
texts.en:
The underground base on [This.GetName] is highly resistant to orbital bombardment, but with enough time and firepower, it is possible to destroy it with our fleet alone. Once the base has been neutralized, we can search the ruins to recover the Celestial Chart piece and any other valuables.

Tactical advisors caution that this approach may allow the Black Needle sufficient time to call for reinforcements.

texts.zh:
我们在黑针基地的废墟中找到了一个地下金库，打开后发现里面藏着他们不义之财的小型宝藏。

安全屋里存放着各种各样的贵重物品，以及与海盗组织历史相关的纪念品。我们在被盗的艺术品、个性化珠宝和加密的数字钱包中找到了星图胶囊。

我们怀疑这里的大多数赃物根本难以销赃。艺术品一看便知，珠宝需要熔化成废料，使用数字钱包进行的交易通常也可以追踪。这些物品的原主人中，有些人可能已经去世，但其他人仍在寻找他们被盗的财产。
texts.en:
Navigating the ruins of the Black Needle base, we found an underground vault and opened it to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.

The safe room contained a wide variety of valuable items as well as sentimental trinkets linked to the history of the pirate organization. We found the chart capsule among stolen artworks, personalized jewelry, and encrypted digital wallets.

We suspect that many of the goods discovered here would be difficult to sell. The artworks are recognizable, the jewelry would need to be melted down for scrap, and transactions using digital wallets are usually traceable. Some of the previous owners of these items could be long-dead, but others will still be looking for their stolen possessions.

texts.zh:

Exploring the battered Black Needle base, we found a blueprint of the facility that revealed the existence of an underground vault. Descending deep beneath the earth in a service elevator, we entered the access code to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.

The safe room contained a wide variety of valuable items as well as sentimental trinkets linked to the history of the pirate organization. We found the chart capsule among stolen artworks, personalized jewelry, and encrypted digital wallets.

We suspect that many of the goods discovered here would be difficult to sell. The artworks are recognizable, the jewelry would need to be melted down for scrap, and transactions using digital wallets are usually traceable. Some of the previous owners of these items could be long-dead, but others will still be looking for their stolen possessions.

texts.zh:
[FromFrom.GetName]地下基地受到大量军队和安保无人机的保护。在行星表面部署军队将使我们能够迅速占领基地，给黑针几乎没有反应的机会。

一旦我们控制了基地，就可以发掘星图胶囊以及海盗积累的任何其他不义之财。
texts.en:
The underground base on [FromFrom.GetName] is protected by a significant number of troops and security drones. Deploying armies on the planet's surface would allow us to take over the base quickly, giving little opportunity for the Black Needle to react.

Once we have secured the base, we can extract the chart capsule and any other ill-gotten goods the pirates have accumulated.

texts.zh: 我方地面部队已攻占了黑针基地，目前正在清剿建筑物及其周围资源。所有威胁已消除，我们可以派遣一名科学家发掘下一块星国图志碎片。
texts.en: Our ground forces have taken the Black Needle base and are currently securing the building and its surrounding resources. With all threats neutralized, we can send in a Scientist to extract the next piece of the Celestial Chart.

tooltips.zh: 黑针的地面势力已经被清除。[FromFromFrom.GetName]可以进行自由探索。
tooltips.en: The Black Needle ground forces have been neutralized. [FromFromFrom.GetName] is now free to be explored.

tooltips.zh: 黑针的地面势力已经被清除。[FromFromFrom.GetName]可以进行自由探索。
tooltips.en: The Black Needle ground forces have been neutralized. [FromFromFrom.GetName] is now free to be explored.

texts.zh:
失落的乙特文明的最后遗迹值得单独展出。

幸运的是，在乙特文物旁边发现的一份蓝图包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
texts.en:
The final trace of the lost Ytterite civilization merits its own exhibition.

Fortunately, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact contains an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the Archive in general.

texts.zh:
除了乙特人标本，我们还发现了一个用于保存标本的复杂展示柜的先进设计。

研究该蓝图中使用的技术可能会帮助未来的保护和展览工作。
texts.en:
Alongside the Ytterite specimen, we discovered an advanced design for a complex display cabinet that would aid in its preservation.

Researching the techniques used in this blueprint will likely aid future conservation and exhibition efforts.

texts.zh:
经过对乙特蓝图的仔细分析，我们建造了一个先进的收纳单元，其大气监测精度可达原子级别。这将使策展员能够高度详细地监控珍贵乙特人标本的大气条件，并检测任何潜在腐烂的预警信号。它将永远保持原样。

我们可以将这些技术应用于进一步改善我们收藏中所有物品的储存条件。
texts.en:
After careful analysis of the Ytterite blueprint, we have constructed an advanced containment unit with precise atmospheric monitoring down to the atom. This would allow curators to monitor the atmospheric conditions of the delicate Ytterite specimen on a highly detailed level and detect any warning signs of potential decay. It will be just as it was, forever.

We can apply these techniques to further improve the storage conditions of every item in our collection.

texts.zh:
在探索宇宙的过程中，我们收集了无数独特的文物和文化奇观。这些标本将激励民众，使我们的展览成为第一个展示和保护所有星系知识领域的展览。

建造一个博物天枢正是为了这一目的。
texts.en:
Throughout our exploration of the cosmos, we have collected countless unique artifacts and cultural oddities. These specimens will inspire the populace and make our exhibition the first to showcase and conserve all fields of galactic knowledge.

Building a Grand Archive would suit this purpose.

texts.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]的博物天枢开张仪式是一个值得全体[this.GetName]庆祝的日子。这场来自全星系的珍宝展览激励着人们的探索精神，也呼唤着我们从过去汲取经验。
texts.en: The opening of the Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] is a great day for the [this.GetName]. This exhibition of treasures from across the galaxy inspires exploration and calls us to learn from the past.

texts.zh:
获得[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]后，我们的科学家认为它应该在博物天枢的公开展示区拥有一席之地。这座建筑将容纳我们不断壮大的珍稀文物收藏，这些文物将带来重大的文化和科学回报。我们将启动一项天使投资，用于保存和展示星系多样化和脆弱标本所需的技术的研发。

此外，在乙特人文物旁还发现了一份蓝图，其中包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
texts.en:
Following the acquisition of the [This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName], our scientists believe that it deserves to be placed on public display in the context of a Grand Archive. This structure would house our budding collection of rare artifacts which will reap significant cultural and scientific returns. An early-stage investment would kickstart the research into the techniques and technologies required to preserve and display the galaxy's diverse and delicate specimens.

Additionally, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact was discovered containing an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the archive in general.
